text_to_image_prompt: Create ONE strict 2D orthographic top-down film-set PLAN for this single location. Image1 is spatial authority; other images provide its appearance. Saltpoint human harbor. Input 1 is authoritative 3D spatial layout: curved continuous waterfront promenade with THREE shop/cafe zones along back (A dive shop at left, B market center, C tavern at right), several timber finger piers reaching toward camera into water, and lighthouse on right outer headland D. Input 2 provides facade style and eye-level views. Follow input1 for the fixed plan. Low white stone buildings, navy awnings, warm lanterns. No fantasy palace. Draw only this location's footprint, with black architectural linework and flat ivory/light blue fills. Top-down furniture footprints, thick wall or rock outlines, openings and fixed circulation. No wall elevations visible, no perspective, no isometric model, no realistic shadows. Do not draw any additional building, bridge, cave, courtyard, entry or connecting room not present in these references. For unshown edges use a plain closed boundary. Sparse SHORT English zone labels, no numbers or dimensions. Portrait 9:16. One plan fills the sheet. No people.
